currency.basis: Live official site in current use (2025 documents) serves the asset; CBR shows an active universal license; the emblem is the present brand mark, not a historical variant.

identity.basis: favicon.svg published on the bank's own domain vlbb.ru; identical emblem in the site's official logo-color.svg lockup beside the 'ВЛАДБИЗНЕСБАНК' wordmark; CBR record ties vlbb.ru to АО «Владбизнесбанк».

assessment.independenceRationale: Regulator registry (cbr.ru) is independent of the bank's site; identity/currency rest on the official publication corroborated by the regulator's live-status record.
uncertainties: The standalone asset is published as the site favicon (browser icon declaration) rather than from a brand-guidelines page; identity corroborated by the identical emblem in the official logo lockup on the same domain.

variant.basis: Standalone emblem variant (favicon.svg) of the same mark geometry/colors (#9d235a) as in the wordmark lockup; wordmark lockup rejected as unsuitable for a square cell, favicon chosen as the standalone form.

candidate.proportionsJudgement: Emblem proportions identical across source reference, final SVG, and both theme renders; the emblem sits centered in the 240x240 frame with comfortable margins, no stretching or cropping.

Suitable standalone square mark.
